attempts_grading.name: attempts_grading
attempts_grading.value: ("attempts"."phase" = 'guess' and "attempts"."rating" is null and "attempts"."rep_number" = 0) or ("attempts"."phase" = 'recall' and "attempts"."rating" between 1 and 4 and "attempts"."rating" is not null and "attempts"."rep_number" > 0 and "attempts"."correct" = ("attempts"."rating" <> 1))
